metric_note: s_i = 1 if reward_info.reward == 1.0 (tau2 success criterion), else 0. With several trials per task, s_i is the mean success over trials; simulations that died on infrastructure errors are excluded.
weighting: score = sum(w_i * s_i); weights normalised so sum(w_i) == 1

upstream.harness: tau2 >= 1.0.0 (v1.0.0 = the τ³-bench release; tau2 run --domain retail)
upstream.dataset: retail domain (114 tasks, τ³ task set)
